basic_details.job_title: NCERT Data Analyst (Gender Studies) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Not more than 45 years / not more than 65 years in case of retired person from Government Organization

qualification.education_qualification: Post-Graduation in Science/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Economics Education/Computer Science/Computer Application or equivalent with minimum 55% marks OR Graduate with 55% marks or equivalent and two-year PG Diploma in Computer Application with 55% marks from any recognized institution; five years' experience in management of large-scale survey data management and data analysis.
qualification.details: Qualification: Post-Graduation in Science/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Economics Education/Computer Science/Computer Application or equivalent with minimum 55% marks; OR Graduate with 55% marks or equivalent and two-year PG Diploma in Computer Application with 55% marks from any recognized institution Experience: Five Years' experience in management of large-scale survey data management and data analysis. Age limit: Not more than 45 years / not more than 65 years in case of retired person from Government Organization Age relaxation: Retired person from Government Organization Not more than 65 years, Others Relaxation as per GoI norms | Desirable: | Working knowledge of data analysis software like SPSS, R, Python, Bilog, ConQuest etc. and IRT.

how_to_apply: Attend the walk-in interview on 02-12-2026 at Department of Gender Studies, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, Sri Aurobindo Marg, New Delhi-110016.
Report at 09:30 AM in Room No. 504 for registration and verification of documents; registration is up to 11:30 AM only.
Bring Resume/Bio-Data, original and self-attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents, and one passport size photograph.
Candidates working with other organizations should forward the application through their employer or submit a No Objection Certificate before the interview.
important_instructions: Candidates may ensure that they fulfil the eligibility conditions. No TA/DA will be paid by NCERT for attending the interview.

rows.national_council_of_educational_research: Department of Gender Studies, NCERT, New Delhi

Post-Graduation in Science/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Economics Education/Computer Science/Computer Application or equivalent with minimum 55% marks OR Graduate with 55% marks or equivalent and two-year PG Diploma in Computer Application with 55% marks from any recognized institution; five years' experience in management of large-scale survey data management and data analysis.
Not more than 45 years / not more than 65 years in case of retired person from Government Organization

content_sections.heading: NCERT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. F. 4.01/2026-27/PAC Prog./DGS/3272 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCERT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-Graduation in Science/Statistics/Mathematics/Commerce/Economics Education/Computer Science/Computer Application or equivalent with minimum 55% marks; OR Graduate with 55% marks or equivalent and two-year PG Diploma in Computer Application with 55% marks from any recognized institution Experience: Five Years' experience in management of large-scale survey data management and data analysis. Age limit: Not more than 45 years / not more than 65 years in case of retired person from Government Organization Age relaxation: Retired person from Government Organization Not more than 65 years, Others Relaxation as per GoI norms Desirable: Working knowledge of data analysis software like SPSS, R, Python, Bilog, ConQuest etc. and IRT.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure: Two Months. Engagement is purely on temporary basis. The selected candidate will be required to join immediately.

rows.event: Walk-in Interview (reporting 09:30 AM, registration up to 11:30 AM)

content_sections.heading: How Will NCERT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Registration and verification of documents Walk-in interview Registration and verification of documents in Room No. 504 from 09:30 AM; registration up to 11:30 AM only.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Resume/Bio-Data Original and self-attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents One passport size photograph No Objection Certificate, for candidates working with other organizations (unless application is forwarded through employer) Attested copy of salary slip/bank statement/ITR, for candidates claiming the required experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCERT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on 02-12-2026 at Department of Gender Studies, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, Sri Aurobindo Marg, New Delhi-110016. Report at 09:30 AM in Room No. 504 for registration and verification of documents; registration is up to 11:30 AM only. Bring Resume/Bio-Data, original and self-attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents, and one passport size photograph. Candidates working with other organizations should forward the application through their employer or submit a No Objection Certificate before the interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates may ensure that they fulfil the eligibility conditions. No TA/DA will be paid by NCERT for attending the interview.
